summary: Code quality is strong: label_assigner.py has clear design, proper type hints, and thoughtful error handling; workflow follows GitHub Actions conventions (pinned refs, least-privilege permissions, job outputs). BUT critical incompleteness: fixture files (fixtures/*/changed_files.txt) referenced by run_act_tests.py do not exist—tests will fail immediately. Missing: conftest.py implies pytest tests that aren't provided, default rules.json and .actrc needed for workflow. Workflow fragility: tee+grep pattern (lines ~54–56) couples output parsing to stderr format. run_act_tests.py structure is sound but untestable without fixtures.
